title: Shared client data across Workspace tools
changes: Added Data selection beside PSM and SQL in Workspace. The selected SAH index stays available for this application session; the SAF payload is read on demand instead of being loaded into memory. Invalid selections preserve the previous client.
Data Editor opens the selected client automatically. Opening another archive in Data Editor updates the shared selection; archive edits refresh the shared index. Existing editor windows are reused.

Client–SQL Sync lists Item, Skill, Monster and Cash SData entries directly from the selected archive, with full paths and repeated-entry identifiers. Select the episode and encoding, then use Load from data; standalone SData selection remains available.

Changing or refreshing the client invalidates archive-based comparisons. Bounded reads and stale-source checks protect comparison, export and synchronization. Added shared-session and Windows UI regression coverage.
The common client-data service provides discovery and bounded reads for future Workspace editors. No WLD/SVMAP editor or new archive-writing feature is included in this release.

title: Client–SQL synchronization workspace
changes: Added Client–SQL Sync to Workspace: select Item, Skill, Monster or Cash SData with EP4.5, EP5.4 or EP6.4 layout profiles and explicit text encoding. Known SEED-encrypted files are read with checksum validation. Custom layouts are rejected.

Compare client values with an existing SQL connection, review field differences, export a transactional SQL update script or synchronize existing records after confirmation. SQL-only fields and records missing from the client are preserved; missing SQL rows are reported, not inserted.

Direct synchronization saves original mapped values locally, rejects stale comparisons and rolls back on failure. SQL exports create a persistent table backup. Episode-specific and uncertain fields are excluded; Monster currently maps only name, level and HP.
Added bounded parsing and regression fixtures plus isolated LocalDB integration coverage. EP4.5 Skill coverage uses a derived fixture; real-client and in-game validation is still required.

title: Persistent SQL sessions, latest logs and full configuration editing
changes: SQL connections now belong to the application. Closing/reopening the SQL panel preserves the connection and database list. Explicit Disconnect or application shutdown closes it.

After a successful manual SQL connection, an opt-in prompt offers automatic startup connection. Saved settings and credentials are protected with Windows DPAPI for the current Windows account; no plaintext SQL password is stored. Connect saved retries the connection, and Forget startup connection deletes the stored profile and disables auto-connect. Startup makes one attempt without repeated background retries.

Log Viewer defaults to Latest logs only, grouping timestamped logs by component/name while retaining distinct error/info suffixes. New logs are discovered periodically during live monitoring; older files remain available with the filter disabled and are never deleted. Grouping is filename-based and scan limits remain visible.

Configuration Editor now opens the full text by default, including every section, comment and value. Optional Fields view includes all keys; server name/IP/port filtering is off by default. Added CONFIG, XML, JSON and non-log TXT discovery, Find next, full-file saves, protected draft closing, and existing backup/encoding/stale-file safeguards.

No automatic decryption or re-encryption is claimed for unknown INI variants. The applicable encrypted format could not be verified; unsupported binary content is refused without modification. Full-text editing does not validate every game-specific setting.
Expanded regression coverage for latest-log grouping, full-text configuration saves, protected credential storage/forget and application-scoped SQL connection lifecycle.

title: Server workspace, configuration tools and dependency checks
changes: Fixed Enter in Data Editor: open the selected file preview or folder before the grid handles row navigation. Holding Enter and multi-selection do not open repeated previews.

Added Dependency Checker to Data Editor for selected files/folders or the current folder. Inspect declared model, MLT and WLD references with missing/ambiguous/unreadable filters, search and source/match navigation. Scans are cancellable and bounded; SData and filename guesses are excluded.

Added PSM/server-files folder selection and SQL Server connection controls to Workspace. SQL supports Windows and SQL authentication, encrypted connections, accessible database listing, refresh and disconnect. Only folder paths and the SQL address are saved locally; passwords are not persisted. This panel does not edit databases.

Added Log Viewer with live two-second tail reading, pause/resume, search, heuristic error/warning filters, encoding selection and follow-latest. Reads the latest 256 KB / 2,000 lines and tolerates active log writers and rotation.

Added Configuration Editor for extracted server/client INI, CFG and CONF text files. Bin paths appear first; quick filters expose server name, IP, host and port fields. Explicit saves preserve encoding, BOM, comments and line endings, retain one session-start backup per file, and reject stale drafts. Password/secret fields are excluded.

Configuration support does not modify binary files, executables, encrypted formats or SData, and does not restart services. Added regression coverage for configuration round trips/backups, log tails/discovery, dependency scanning, Enter routing and Windows tool lifecycle.

title: Organized related files
changes: Added a dark/gold category sidebar to every Related files window, including model texture mapping results. Only populated categories are shown, with reference-entry counts and an All files option.

Separated WLD buildings, shapes, trees, grass, objects, terrain textures, music and sounds; other asset types are grouped into models, textures, animations, worlds, effects and texture mappings. Search filters the selected category; missing and ambiguous references retain their status and exact-record navigation.

title: Bulk archive editing, undo and connected 3D previews
changes: Added Ctrl/Shift multi-selection, recursive folder import, extraction with archive paths, and bulk file/folder deletion. Each import or deletion commits as one operation; cancelling an import leaves the original index unchanged. Completed extractions remain on disk after cancellation.

Added Undo and Ctrl+Z for archive imports, replacements, text saves and deletions. History is kept for this editor session (up to 20 changes / 128 MB of indexes); the single session-start backup remains. Old SAF payload bytes are retained; no archive compaction is performed.

Added model texture selection per mesh part, MLT texture mapping discovery, and explicit pairing of compatible 3DC skeletons with ANI animations. Includes key scrubbing, optional 15 fps preview playback, pan and zoom. Pairing is preview-only; matching bone counts alone do not prove matching rigs.

Added bounded WLD scene previews with signed-height terrain, terrain textures and static placed models/dungeon layouts. Object search, focus and missing/ambiguous/budget statuses are shown. Terrain is simplified; effects, lightmaps, blending, gameplay and MANI object animation are not simulated.

Added searchable Related files with declared texture/world/MLT references and exact-record navigation. Missing and ambiguous matches are shown; scanned strings and filename suggestions are explicitly unverified. SData interpretation remains deferred.

Added archive transaction/undo tests, real skeleton and dungeon fixtures, hierarchy/interpolation checks, and Windows bulk/animation/world UI coverage. Native readers were also checked against a real 2,048-unit field with 13,638 placements.

title: Explore native models, animations, media and every non-SData file
changes: Enabled Preview for every non-SData file. Unknown formats, unsupported variants and oversized decoded previews open a clearly labeled read-only hex/ASCII inspector with 4 KB pages, byte-offset navigation and strings from the current page. SData preview remains disabled for the future studio integration.

Added orbit/zoom 3D views for classic 3DC/3DC_, 3DO, SMOD and DG geometry, with bounded resolution of unambiguous embedded texture references. 3DC shows the base mesh; skeletal ANI playback, collision overlays and dungeon lightmaps are not rendered.

Added 3DE/VANI vertex-frame scrubbing and optional 15 fps preview playback. ANI exposes bone matrices and rotation/translation keys; MANI exposes rotation properties. These inspectors are not character animation playback.
Added WLD field height-sample images and dungeon layout references. Full world placement/effect rendering is not implemented; raw bytes remain accessible.

Expanded images to GIF/TIFF/ICO/CUR first-frame previews and added media playback controls for WAV/MP3/WMA/OGG/FLAC/MP4/AVI/WMV when Windows codecs support the file. Media uses a temporary copy removed on preview close; playback starts only on Play. No embedded executable or script is launched.

Preserved text Edit/Save, direct archive imports/deletion and the single session backup. Added independent native-format fixtures, malformed/count-limit checks, paged-byte verification and Windows model/raw/media-lifecycle tests.

title: Edit text directly inside archives
changes: Added Edit, Save and Ctrl+S to supported text previews. Save writes directly to the selected archive record without manual extraction or import.
Preserves text encoding and BOM; uses the original newline style for edited content. Unrepresentable characters and text exceeding 2 MB are rejected without saving.
Reuses atomic index replacement and the single session backup. Stale indexes are rejected; unsaved text prompts before closing the editor. Images remain read only.
Added encoding round-trip, repeated-record text replacement and Windows Edit/Save tests.

title: Read text and preview archive textures
changes: Added read-only previews for TXT and common text/configuration files, PNG, JPG/JPEG, BMP, TGA and supported ordinary 2D DDS textures. Open with double-click, Enter, Preview or the right-click menu.

Text supports BOM detection, UTF-8 and fallback to the archive filename encoding. Images fit a separate dark-and-gold preview window. Missing SAF, unsupported texture variants and invalid files show errors without changing archive data.
Added bounded in-memory reads: text up to 2 MB, encoded images up to 64 MB, decoded images up to 16 megapixels and 8192 pixels per side. No external applications are launched.

Removed the default white context-menu gutter with a fully themed menu template. Renamed the session backup folder to data.sah backup (or the corresponding archive basename); existing Turkish-named backups remain untouched.
Added bounded-read, text-encoding and Windows image-decoding/preview tests. 3DC, ANI and SData content previews remain planned.

title: Delete archive files and keep one session backup
changes: Added Delete for the selected archive file, plus a dark-and-gold right-click menu with Extract file and Delete file. Right-click selects the targeted row.
Deletion removes only the selected index record, including when names repeat, updates file counts and saves automatically. SAF payload bytes remain intact; this does not compact the archive.

Replaced per-operation timestamped backups with one session-start index at <archive>.sah yedeği/<archive>.sah. It is saved before the first change, retained through all imports and deletions in the editor window, and refreshed by the next editing session.
Added regression checks for exact-record deletion, retained payloads, single-session backup behavior and Windows context-menu deletion.

title: Data Editor: import, replace and extract
changes: Renamed the Workspace tool to Data Editor and replaced the record-number column with gold file-type icons. Record numbers remain in details and repeated-name labels.

Added Add / overwrite and drag-and-drop import into the current archive folder. Matching names replace the existing record; ambiguous duplicates require Replace selected. Each file saves automatically.
Added Replace selected and Extract file. Editing and extraction require the matching SAF next to the SAH; index-only browsing remains available.

Payload writes append to SAF before atomically replacing SAH. Each successful edit keeps a uniquely named previous-index backup; existing payload bytes and unrelated index metadata are preserved. Replaced payloads are not compacted.

Added stale-index and payload-range checks, bounded streaming, background operations, and parser/editor plus Windows UI regression tests. No patch generation, SData table editing or universal custom-format compatibility is included.

title: Compact workspace cards and repeated SAH records
changes: Replaced the large Workspace introduction with a compact Data Viewer card matching Information. File selection and drag-and-drop remain available.

Fixed the reader rejecting an entire index with 'Duplicate archive entry name'. Repeated files, case-only paths and repeated folders are now retained as separate records with a warning and visible record numbers.
Show folder and parent navigation now use record identity, so duplicate folder paths do not send a search result to the wrong folder.

Added parser and Windows regression checks for repeated records, different offsets, file/folder collisions and unchanged source files. A separate public EP4.5 RU index was checked with 23,533 files; the reported duplicate condition is covered by dedicated fixtures.

title: Explore Shaiya archives with Data Viewer
changes: Added Data Viewer to Workspace. Open a .sah file with the file picker or drop it onto Workspace to open a separate dark-and-gold reader window.
Browse folders and subfolders, inspect file names, types, sizes and 64-bit SAF offsets, copy internal paths and reveal search results in their parent folders.
Added debounced whole-archive search (Ctrl+F) and quick filters for all files, .sdata, items, skills and NPC/quest resources. Large lists use UI virtualization.

Added selectable filename encodings and a bounded, cancellable, read-only SAH parser. Failed opens retain the previous archive. No SAF payloads are loaded, files extracted or SData tables decoded in this first release.

Validated an independent SAH fixture and a real EP3 index with 21,523 files, plus malformed files, cancellation, encoding and 50,000-entry tests. Added a Windows viewer navigation scenario and format attribution.

title: A new home for development workflows
changes: Added Workspace to the top of the sidebar with a matching gold active icon and a dedicated dark-and-gold introductory screen.
Workspace is the starting point for upcoming project and management features. No project creation, server control or database operations are enabled in this release.
Preserved Information as the opening page and retained the existing Tools launcher. Added a Windows navigation check covering the new page and sidebar spacing.

title: Clearer downloads, round controls and more Shaiya knowledge
changes: Changed the Support and download queue close controls to compact circular buttons with centered icons and keyboard focus support.

Expanded Information from 41 to 50 articles and from 33 to 39 sources. Added the official Fawkes overview, historical race/class relationships and party roles, archive tool capabilities, and the context needed to read legacy RaGEZONE setup guides.

Added the shStudio author's 0.9.0.6 monster-data saving fix with a maintainer-confirmed label and version limits. Added separate FixRange editing guidance; unresolved issues are not presented as fixed.

Replaced SSMS 22 with the owner-requested Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 19.3 standalone installer. Verified the full download size, SHA-256 and embedded product version; SQL Server 2019 Express remains a separate unchanged download.
Added optional file descriptions to explain installer purpose before download. Previous SSMS metadata is archived outside the active catalog.

Updated the Turkish support setup guide with Patreon Shop one-time purchases, clearly separated from recurring membership and direct donations. Support remains inactive until a real public page is configured.

title: A growing library and everyday developer tools
changes: Expanded Information from 19 to 41 articles across seven categories, with 33 named sources. Added class and faction concepts, database files, transactions, permissions, restore checks, configuration routing, map editing, encoding, file hashes and change review.

Added five resolution articles: three maintainer-confirmed Parsec fixes (versions 1.1.0, 1.1.1 and 1.2.0) and Microsoft-documented SQL 18456/4064 diagnostic routes. Resolution labels distinguish published evidence from local reproduction; no universal episode compatibility is claimed.

Files now supports a persistent sequential download queue. Add more files while a transfer runs; inspect, reorder or remove waiting items in a dedicated queue window. Pause stops the queue; an error preserves the current partial file and waiting work for an explicit retry.

Queue state survives application restarts and preserves existing single-download resume data. Downloads do not start automatically when reopening the application. Finished files expose Open folder; program files are never executed by the downloader.

Added Tools, a local program launcher with executable selection, friendly names, saved shortcuts, launch, relocation and shortcut-only removal. Missing executables are identified. Programs launch only on an explicit click.

Added a dark-and-gold Support the project button and window. The external payment link is remotely configurable; it remains disabled until the owner supplies a real support page. Added a Turkish Patreon setup and payout guide.

Extended automated checks for queue ordering, duplicate destinations, interruptions, promotion recovery, launcher persistence, support URLs and solution labels; added Windows UI scenarios for the queue, tools and support windows.

title: A source-backed knowledge library
changes: Information now opens a live knowledge library with seven categories: Shaiya, Server Side, SQL & Database, Client Side, Editing Tools, Development Tools and Troubleshooting.
Added 19 introductory articles with named sources, review dates, scope notes and clear distinctions between documented information, inspected packages and recommended workflows.

Category cards open a separate dark-and-gold reader with a topic menu, category selection, article search, source links and readable code examples. Close the reader or press Esc to return to your workspace.
Knowledge content loads from GitHub and can be expanded without a new app release. Validated saved content remains available offline; invalid updates do not replace the last good copy.

EP6.4 service/configuration articles are based on static package inspection. Original-game technology and unverified historical dates are not asserted as facts. No server, SQL query or example command is executed by the reader.
Added schema/search/cache tests and Windows reader checks covering category navigation, empty search results, source visibility and returning to the main window.

title: Refreshed tools & cleaner window controls
changes: Fixed title-bar and About buttons keeping a highlight after minimize/restore or closing About. Keyboard navigation still has a dedicated focus outline.
Moved all five EP5.4 references out of the active library into content/disabled/ep5.4-references.json, ready to restore later.
Replaced generic SSMS entries with SQL Server 2019 Express (64-bit) and SSMS 22, which supports SQL Server 2019.
Updated developer tools to Visual Studio Community 2026 Stable, XAMPP 8.5.12 (64-bit), and Visual Studio Code 1.146.0 (64-bit), using verified official download sources.
Archived the old VS Code 32-bit entry because the current version no longer supports 32-bit Windows. Previous tool records remain available in content/disabled/superseded-tools-2026-11-12.json.
The active catalog now contains 133 entries. New download links passed executable-signature and HTTP range checks; installers were not run.

title: The purpose behind the workspace
changes: Added a gold information icon beside the title-bar window controls.
A dedicated About window introduces the project's purpose, current features and future direction in clear English, written from the perspective of its solo developer.
Future guides, a growing resource library, server management and theme preferences are clearly labeled as plans rather than available features.
The About window matches the dark-and-gold theme, scales to fit smaller screens, and closes with Esc, the close icon or Back to workspace. Your current workspace stays in place.

title: Faster closing & the first resource library
changes: Idle windows close directly without re-entering the Closing event.
Active downloads finish cancellation after the window is hidden, preserving resume data.
Online content requests are cancelled on exit; transfer I/O stays off the UI thread.

Migrated 106 original resource files to shDeveloperTool Releases and added a complete SQL query pack. The 21 verified external downloads remain on their original hosting services. The old repository was preserved.

Organized the library into Client & Server Files, SQL Programs & Queries, Editing & Developer Tools, and Design & Web. Client/server files use episode filters; SQL programs use bit architecture filters.

Corrected the EP6.4 server pack previously labeled 6.3 and removed the incorrect R2 label from SQL Server 2012. Distinguished the two Bankteller fixes and gave client downloads explicit language labels.

title: An always-current library
changes: File catalog and release history now load from GitHub without reinstalling the app.
Refresh controls and a validated offline cache for both content sources.
Bundled catalog and release-history files are no longer distributed.

title: GitHub release updates
changes: Automatic update checks now use the public GitHub release repository.
Windows installer and update bundle build workflow.
Resource downloads are paused before applying an application update.

title: A simpler library
changes: Four grouped collections with context-aware category filters.
Episode for client/server files; bit architecture for SQL programs.
Gold pill buttons and download controls that appear only when needed.
Full release history with a slim gold scrollbar.

title: A download library built to resume
changes: Browse catalog files by category, episode and language.
Pause and resume downloads, including after restarting the app.
Progress, saved transfer state and optional SHA-256 verification.
Fixed-size workspace with paged lists instead of scrollbars.

Four resource collections with local file selection and file details.
Release history is loaded from a bundled JSON file.

YouTube, GitHub and website shortcuts.
